pass_1.why_it_was_not_enough: Every mutant was an EXISTENCE mutant (delete a clause) or a polarity flip. The rule's WIDTH clause asks for narrowings too, and the review lenses proved five separate narrowings would have survived pass 1 - including dropping the single errno member (`permission denied`) that a chmod-refused admin directory actually produces on git 2.43, and widening SKIP by one live root, which B0's anti-vacuity floor cannot see (1723 -> 1650, still far above its 200 threshold). The pass-1 record ALSO mislabelled M4/M5 as narrowings; deleting one arm of a two-clause AND makes the predicate accept MORE strings, which is a widening. Both errors are corrected here.

derivation: code-derived: every mutant is drawn from a decision in the source under test (the SKIP tuple, the path normalisation, and classify_add's three arms), never from reading the cases and asking what would break them
sweep: one sequential sweep, files patched on disk and restored in a finally; restore verified byte-identical against the pre-sweep sha256 of both files
result: 11/11 killed, each by its DECLARED case

mutants.decision_mutated: is_skipped() matches the path against the SKIP markers
mutants.mutant: widen the skip to every path (return True)

mutants.decision_mutated: scan_path() normalises to a ROOT-relative path before matching

mutants.note: this is the trap the marker creates and the reason the normalisation exists: a lane checkout LIVES at <root>/.claude/worktrees/<lane>/, so an absolute match would skip every file of a lane run and report a vacuous clean scan of nothing

mutants.decision_mutated: the path needle is .git/worktrees, the ADMIN directory
mutants.mutant: loosen the needle to a bare "worktrees"
mutants.note: SURVIVED pass 1. The loosened predicate excuses a read-only refusal of a LANE CHECKOUT directory, which the control's own failure message declares must still fail

mutants.mutant: the success arm returns skip instead of run
mutants.note: reachable only because the THREE-WAY decision now lives in one pure function; while it was a predicate plus an `if` at the call site, this arm had no named case at all

width_note: M7-M11 are the NARROWING mutants the rule asks for, and all five SURVIVED pass 1. Each drops one member from a matched class, loosens one needle to a substring, or flips one arm of the three-way decision - the shapes a real regression actually takes. M4 and M5 are their WIDENING counterparts (delete a whole clause); pass 1's record called those two narrowings, which was wrong, because deleting one arm of an AND makes the predicate accept more, not less.
review_provenance: M7-M11 were not found by the builder. The code-review lens fan-out proved each one survives, with real counts and a live git reproduction; they were added, and the code was changed so M11 is reachable at all.
